AboutHeroTitle: Passion for Computing, Mathematics, and Teaching.
AboutHeroDesc: I hold a degree in Systems Engineering from San Carlos University of Guatemala (CUNOC) and am currently pursuing a Master's in Industrial Engineering specializing in Computer Science, focused on large-scale data interpretation.
DevPhilosophyP1: Throughout my career, I have engineered robust distributed web applications for national and international clients. My primary languages are TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, and Java, backed by container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes) and continuous delivery with ArgoCD.
DevPhilosophyP2: My affinity for mathematics drives me to tackle problems from foundational logic: from compiler optimization design to predictive modeling in Python and R.
TeachingVocationDesc: I firmly believe that the best way to master engineering is to teach it with technical rigor, real-world examples, and modern interactivity. That is why I design Reveal.js slides with live interactive simulators for architectures like RISC-V.
AIDesc: Certified by NVIDIA in Deep Learning fundamentals. Passionate about exploring language models, neural networks, and computer vision for predictive analysis and automation.
